The beach isn’t just for summer! Book a fall vacation and have a beach bonfire!

This is the perfect family vacation home. Located steps from the beach with public restrooms and picnic tables. This home has everything you need to make those wonderful family memories. After a day at the beach, relax in the shaded private pool or have a family cookout on the pool deck.

Summer Breeze on 30A is a 6 bedroom, 5 bathroom home. You can comfortably sleep 18 people. Leave the cars in the driveway and walk to the nearby ice cream shop, bicycle rentals or have a paddle board delivered to you beach side. The many nearby restaurants feature nightly entertainment and great food, Goatfeathers, Local Catch and Shunk Gully to name a few.
Nearby, Gulf Place Town Center features clothing, beach and paddle board shops, weekly concerts, coffee shop, arcade and liquor stores as well. Get your essential at the nearby Walmart or Publix grocery stores.
